en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand neoclassical theatre building with a large central dome, ornate sculptures and columns. The building stands on a corner with a curved driveway and landscaped garden in front. Surrounding streets feature horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians, suggesting an early 20th‑century city scene. The printed captions at the top read "Graz." and "Stadttheater."
